entries.divergence: Paper specifies a single-pass blur with radius = f(history count) (Figure 19 'Dilated blur mask'). Capsaicin implements exactly that. Ours is a 3-pass SVGF à-trous cascade with moments-based variance (from Schied 2017's unrelated SVGF paper). See TASK-125 for re-alignment plan.
Entire file should not exist under the paper's design — paper calls for single-pass variable-radius blur, not à-trous strides. See TASK-125.
